identity.title: JWST reveals extended stellar disks for ALMA-bright dusty star-forming galaxies in the Spiderweb protocluster

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present JWST/NIRCam imaging of dusty star-forming galaxies (DSFGs) detected by Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) in the Spiderweb protocluster at $z=2.16$.

evidence.quote: which corresponds to a scale of 0.490 physical Mpc (pMpc) or 1.549 comoving Mpc (cMpc) per arcmin at $z=2.16$.

question.value: What are the stellar morphologies, sizes and size-wavelength trends of ALMA-detected DSFGs in the Spiderweb protocluster, as seen with JWST/NIRCam, compared with field DSFGs?

evidence.quote: we utilize newly acquired JWST data (cite: Shimakawa2024b; Perez2024b) to identify ALMA-detected DSFGs and construct the first statistical sample of DSFGs in $z\sim2$ protocluster environments.

method.value: Cross-match catalogs with 0.5'' radius; detection in more than one NIRCam filter

evidence.quote: By cross-matching the ALMA and JWST/NIRCam catalogs with a 0.5$''$ radius, we identified 30 ALMA sources located within the JWST coverage.

evidence.quote: We only retain robust results with a flag equal zero (cite: Rodriguez-Gomez2019), or an S/N per pixel greater than two (cite: Lotz2004).

validation.value: Consistency with statmorph outputs from Galight

evidence.quote: We confirm the reliability of our results by validating the consistency of `statmorph` outputs across both approaches.

method.value: Galight single Sersic fits with empirical median-stacked PSF; 1 sigma posterior intervals

evidence.quote: We fit the target galaxy along with any possible nearby companions with single Sérsic model, and mask out other sources within each cutout.
We determine the uncertainty for each parameter by deriving the 1$\sigma$ interval of the posterior distribution.

results_numeric.quantity: Median stellar mass of DSFG members

we obtain an even steeper slope of $-1.20\pm0.30$ for our DSFG members

findings_qualitative.value: DSFG members have larger stellar sizes than coeval field DSFGs and protocluster HAEs at fixed mass

evidence.quote: In summary, our sample exhibits larger sizes than both typical HAEs in protoclusters and field DSFGs at similar redshifts.

claims.hypothesis: DSFGs in the Spiderweb protocluster have larger stellar disks than field DSFGs
claims.experiment: Sersic fits in F115W/F182M/F410M compared with literature field samples
claims.result: Systematically larger Re at similar redshift and mass
claims.finding: Accelerated size growth in dense environments

evidence.quote: It is clearly seen that, our DSFG sample exhibits systematically larger effective radii relative to field DSFGs at similar redshifts.

claims.hypothesis: Mergers drive star formation in these DSFGs
claims.result: Most are late-type disks; merger fraction 20-30%
claims.finding: Secular processes likelier than major mergers

evidence.quote: their overall star formation is more likely driven by secular processes rather than major mergers.

limitations_admitted.value: Small sample from a single protocluster; tentative conclusions

evidence.loc: 4.1 The origin of extended stellar disks
evidence.quote: given the limited sample size and focus on a single protocluster, larger samples across multiple protoclusters are needed to confirm this scenario.
